findings.evidence: The only apply lemmas in the file are `enlargeBlock_apply_zero/one` at lines 124 and 129; `enlargeColumn` and `enlargeRow` at lines 143 and 155 have none.

findings.evidence: The theorem rewrites `alexanderMatrix V i j` to `T 1 * C (V i j) - C (V j i)`, while later proofs repeatedly invoke it explicitly through `simp [...]`.
findings.fix: Annotate `alexanderMatrix_apply` with `@[simp]`; its right-hand side contains no `alexanderMatrix`, so this is terminating.

summary: The enlargement operations lack an elimination API, and a basic Alexander-matrix normal form is missing its automation annotation.
